sources.text: Search this site Embedded Files Tehrani Group Advanced Multifunctional Composites • Additive Manufacturing • Carbonaceous Conductors Welcome to Tehrani Group website! We are a Structural Engineering and Materials Engineering research lab at UC San Diego . Our research lies at the intersection of advanced manufacturing, materials science, mechanics, and physics. It encompasses various fields including Advanced Manufactured Carbon fiber Composite Structures, Advanced Electrical Conductors, and Multi-Functional Films (with a focus on 2D materials).
